# Pulumi.jl

> A community Julia SDK for Pulumi: define cloud infrastructure in Julia.

Pulumi.jl is an experimental, community-developed SDK. It is not an
official product of Pulumi Corporation.

## Docs

- [Home](https://s-celles.github.io/Pulumi.jl/)
- [API Reference](https://s-celles.github.io/Pulumi.jl/api/)
- [Internals](https://s-celles.github.io/Pulumi.jl/internals/)
- [Maintenance](https://s-celles.github.io/Pulumi.jl/maintenance/)
